title: CPR

nodes.text: Scene Safety: Look for any dangers or hazards

evidence.source_text: 1. Scene Safety: Look for any dangers or hazards.

nodes.text: Determine Responsiveness: Tap on the patient's shoulders and shout 'Are you OK?' Look for chest rise and fall

evidence.source_text: 2. Determine Responsiveness: Tap on the patients shoulders and shout, Are you OK? Look for chest rise and fall.
If the patient is not breathing, continue with steps 3 and 4. If the patient is breathing and no spinal injury is suspected, place patient on their side.

nodes.text: Place patient on their side. Continue to monitor breathing

evidence.source_text: place patient on their side. Continue to monitor breathing.
If the patient is breathing and no spinal injury is suspected, place patient on their side.

nodes.text: Monitor breathing (patient breathing, no spinal injury)
Call for Help: Activate emergency response. If possible, obtain an AED

evidence.source_text: 3. Call for Help: Activate emergency response. If possible, obtain an automated external defibrillator (AED).

nodes.text: Chest Compressions: Place heel of one hand on center of patient's chest, other hand over first, interlock fingers. Perform compressions at 100-120/min, at least 2 inches deep. Perform 30 compressions

evidence.source_text: 4. Chest Compressions: Place the heel of one hand on the center of the patients chest. Place the other hand over the first and interlock the fingers. Perform compressions at a rate of 100 to 120 per minute, compressing the patients chest at least two inches. Push hard and fast. Perform 30 compressions.

nodes.text: Airway: Open the patient's airway by tilting the head back and lifting the chin. If trauma suspected and trained, use the jaw thrust

evidence.source_text: 5. Airway: Open the patients airway by tilting the head back and lifting the chin. If trauma is suspected and you are trained, use the jaw thrust.
If possible, use a barrier device. ... If no barrier device is available, perform continuous compressions with no breaks or perform mouth-to-mouth.

nodes.text: Breathing: Place barrier device over patient's nose and mouth. Pinch nose and give 2 breaths, making chest rise

evidence.source_text: Place the barrier device over the patients nose and mouth. Pinch the patients nose and give 2 breaths, making the chest rise.

nodes.text: Breathing: Perform continuous compressions with no breaks, or perform mouth-to-mouth (pinch nose, cover mouth, form airtight seal, give 2 breaths)

evidence.source_text: If no barrier device is available, perform continuous compressions with no breaks or perform mouth-to-mouth.

nodes.text: Continue CPR: Alternate 30 compressions and 2 breaths. If second rescuer arrives, one performs ventilations, one performs compressions. Maintain 30:2 ratio

evidence.source_text: 7. Continue CPR: Continue alternating 30 compressions and 2 breaths. If a second rescuer arrives, one person can perform ventilations and one person can perform compressions. Maintain the same 30:2 ratio.
8. AED: If an AED arrives, turn the AED on and follow the instructions provided.

nodes.text: Turn AED on and follow the instructions provided

evidence.source_text: turn the AED on and follow the instructions provided.

nodes.text: AED in use / CPR cycle continues

evidence.source_text: 8. AED: If an AED arrives, turn the AED on and follow the instructions provided.
